desc: Ideation complete: Analyzed problem constraints and proposed DP + sliding window median approach.
Implement a sliding window median finder with sum tracking to compute `cost[i]` for all valid windows ending at `i`.
Set up a DP table of size (n+1) x (k+1) initialized to infinity, with DP[0][0] = 0.
Iterate through each position i from 1 to n, and for each possible count j from 0 to k, update the DP table by considering skipping the current element or forming a new subarray ending at i.
When forming a subarray ending at i, ensure that the subarray starts at i-x+1 >= 0, compute the cost, and update DP[i][j] from DP[i-x][j-1] + cost.
Return DP[n][k] as the result, ensuring it is not infinity.
